description: Open an Audiograph link someone shared (https://audiograph.si/a/...) for the person you are working with, and read it: the recorded conversation’s transcript, its notes (summary, action items, decisions) and the people and places mentioned. Works for one Audiograph, several sent together, or a MindShare invite. Opening it adds it to their Audiograph library, the same as tapping the link on their iPhone. Long transcripts are cut off; pass recording_id to read one in full.

recording_id.description: Optional: read only this recording of the link, in full.

url.description: The link, exactly as shared: https://audiograph.si/a/<token>.

name: audiograph_open_link
title: Open an Audiograph link
